# PR — R7.9: DF-R7.1-2 unblock — SSE usage capture + live probe + V3/V4/V5 measured refold

Manifest 342 (FINAL row) · machinery + live stage · **USD $0.000007
measured vs $25 bound** · branch `codex/harnessharness-r6.53` ·
depends on R7.8.

## What

Closes DF-R7.1-2. Three parts: the usage-capture machinery the
unblocker names, the operator-directed conditional probe window
executed inside the pre-authorized envelope, and the committed
corpus+refold that turns V3/V4/V5's `unmeasured{evidence_absent}`
into measured fold verdicts.

### Machinery (AC-1)

`hh-hosting`'s `usage_cost` now extracts usage from SSE terminal
chunks — openai.chat's trailing `{"choices":[],"usage":{…}}` frame
and anthropic.messages' `message_start`/`message_delta` merge — and
`model.call.completed` carries `tokens.input.uncached` per call. The
W-rule corpus recorded `usage.source: absent` on every pi/claude
call precisely because those calls were streams; streams without a
usage member still fold honest `absent` (never fabricated).
Fixture `crates/hh-hosting/tests/r7_9.rs` (3/3) fails without the
change.

### Probe (AC-2)

Estimate = the slot `slice_micros` bound itself: **$0.25 ≤ $25** →
executed under `ws1-proxy-session.py --mode live` on the local host
(no VM — the bound admits "at most one probe VM", zero is inside).
Live streamed `openai.chat` call vs `ollama.com` ledgered
`tokens.input.uncached: 19` with `measurement.cost.attributed` 7 µ$ —
the end-to-end proof the retained W4x root could not give (its
receipts predate the machinery). `include_usage`-less stream stayed
honest-estimate. Run-root retained `~/hh-retained/r7.9-probe/`;
record `docs/build/reports/2026-11-26-r7.9-usage-probe.json`.

### Corpus + refold

- `scripts/p4-activation-corpus.py` →
  `docs/build/reports/2026-11-26-fp-p4-activation-corpus.json` —
  5,124 calls / 49 subjects over the retained W4x root; input_manifest
  covers the missing usage sources; activation inputs name the
  registry's declared metrics.
- `fp_p4_refold` + `p4_activation_refold` →
  `docs/build/reports/2026-11-26-fp-p4-activation-refold.json` —
  **V3 withheld{inert_predicted} 4/49 (81,632 ppm) · V4
  withheld{inert_predicted} 267/1441 (185,287 ppm, exact) · V5
  admitted{forecast_ok} 1354/5124 (264,246 ppm)**. Measured,
  never promoted: the below-floor shares fold `withheld` verbatim.
- REQ-XD-205/209: the corpus's `selected_fields` re-checks
  non-outcome before any read; outcome-named fields refuse.
